title: HTTP Server
description: PROGRAM: HTTP Server (http server). A tiny HTTP server (stdlib http.server) that starts in a background thread, serves one request, and shuts down cleanly — a complete client/server round-trip in one script. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3 """HTTP server demo: serve one request in a thread, fetch it, shut down.""" import threading, urllib.request from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def do_GET(self): body = b"

Hello from JAH HTTP server

" self.send_response(200) self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) def log_message(self, *a): pass def main(): server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler) port = server.server_address[1] t = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True) t.start() print("server listening on 127.0.0.1:%d" % port) with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%d/" % port, timeout=10) as r: body = r.read().decode() print("client got status", r.status, "body:", body) assert r.status == 200 and "JAH HTTP server" in body server.shutdown() server.server_close() print("OK: full HTTP round-trip completed, server shut down cleanly") if __name__ == "__main__": main()

title: Unit Converter
description: PROGRAM: Unit Converter (unit converter). Converts temperature (C/F/K) and length (m/ft/mi/km) with dimensional sanity checks. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unit converter: temperature + length."""
def c_to_f(c): return c * 9 / 5 + 32
def f_to_c(f): return (f - 32) * 5 / 9
def c_to_k(c): return c + 273.15

LENGTH = {"m": 1.0, "km": 1000.0, "ft": 0.3048, "mi": 1609.344}
def convert_length(value, from_u, to_u):
    return value * LENGTH[from_u] / LENGTH[to_u]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("100 C =", c_to_f(100), "F =", c_to_k(100), "K")
    assert c_to_f(100) == 212.0 and f_to_c(32) == 0.0 and c_to_k(0) == 273.15
    mi = convert_length(10, "km", "mi")
    print("10 km =", mi, "mi")
    assert abs(mi - 6.21371) < 1e-4
    print("OK: temperature and length conversions verified")

title: Dice Statistics
description: PROGRAM: Dice Statistics (dice statistics). Rolls dice (seeded) and compares observed frequencies to the theoretical distribution. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Dice statistics: seeded rolls vs theory."""
import random
from collections import Counter

def roll_die(rng):
    return rng.randint(1, 6)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(7)
    rolls = [roll_die(rng) for _ in range(6000)]
    freq = Counter(rolls)
    print("faces:", dict(sorted(freq.items())))
    for face in range(1, 7):
        assert 850 < freq[face] < 1150, "face %d out of range" % face
    total2d = sum(rng.randint(1, 6) + rng.randint(1, 6) for _ in range(3600))
    mean = total2d / 3600
    print("2d6 mean over 3600 rolls:", round(mean, 3), "(theory: 7.0)")
    assert abs(mean - 7.0) < 0.15
    print("OK: uniform faces and 2d6 mean match theory")

title: Palindrome Checker
description: PROGRAM: Palindrome Checker (palindrome checker). Detects palindromes ignoring case, spaces, and punctuation — with Unicode-safe normalization. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Palindrome checker: normalized, case- and punctuation-insensitive."""
import re

def is_palindrome(text):
    clean = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", text.lower())
    return clean == clean[::-1] and len(clean) > 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cases = [("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama", True),
             ("racecar", True), ("hello", False),
             ("Was it a car or a cat I saw?", True), ("", False)]
    for text, want in cases:
        got = is_palindrome(text)
        print("%-35s -> %s" % (repr(text), got))
        assert got == want
    print("OK: all 5 palindrome cases correct")
